lines.en: Leaves in my beak, a low rumble.
snaps its beak on the ground
lightly flaps its wings forward
turns its head to search for food
moves quickly with short legs
emits a sharp call
spreads its strong wings

lines.zh: 我沿着蕨根一路啄过去。
lines.en: I peck my way along the fern roots.
swings its wings to create a breeze
strolls slowly, eyes on the surroundings
Nipping tender leaves down low with my beak.

lines.zh: 在灌木间小跑，尾巴摆动。
lines.en: Trotting through shrubs, tail swinging.
Steady on two strong hind legs.

lines.zh: 带崽的队伍慢慢穿过蕨丛。
lines.en: Leading the young through the ferns.
closes its eyes to rest
grooming its feathers leisurely

lines.zh: 我趴在暖石上，尾巴贴地。
lines.en: I lie on a warm stone with my tail flat against it.
yawns and stretches lazily

lines.zh: 转动身体寻找舒适位置
lines.en: turns its body to find a comfortable position
opens its mouth to sun itself
taps the ground gently with its feet
stands still quietly
grooming and making a soft gurgling sound
Rolling in the sand to clean my hide.
Burying my head in the ferns.
Refusing to leave the nest of eggs.
Swallowing pebbles to help digest.
Cocking my head at distant sounds.
suddenly looks at the player
gives a warning call

lines.zh: 低吼，警告玩家不要靠近
lines.en: growls, warning the player not to approach

lines.zh: 我张嘴露出喙缘，别靠近巢。
lines.en: I open my beak to show its edge; stay away from the nest.
swings its wings to drive the player away
emits a sharp warning

lines.zh: 发出咕噜声，似乎准备攻击
lines.en: makes a low growl, ready to attack

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，准备发起攻击
lines.en: staring at the player, ready to attack

lines.zh: 发出咕咕声，警告玩家远离
lines.en: gurgling, warning the player to stay away

lines.zh: 我的喙合上了，就是准备好了。
lines.en: Beak closed means I'm ready.
spreads its wings, preparing to fly away
You stepped near my nest.
That hit nearly took the meat off me.
My leg is hurt, I can't walk.

lines.zh: 我的短翅膀本来就飞不远。
lines.en: My stubby wings never carried me far anyway.
I'm starving, gotta find food.
I'm hurt, need Mommy.
I'm bleeding, it hurts!

lines.zh: 后腿挨了一下，我跑不快了。
lines.en: A blow lands on my hind leg and I cannot run.

lines.zh: 从石头上滑下来，蹭破了皮。
lines.en: I slid off the rock and scraped my hide.
Drowned, the water was cold.

lines.zh: 背上麻了一片，羽毛立着。
lines.en: My back goes numb and my feathers stand up.

lines.zh: 我那美丽的头冠能吸引你吗？
lines.en: Can my beautiful crest tempt you?
Come, try my deliciousness.

lines.zh: 我拥有刷怪蛋，你想要吗？
lines.en: I have spawn eggs, do you want some?
My meat is fragrant, don't miss it.

lines.zh: 看看我的飞行技巧，如何？
lines.en: Watch my flight skills, how are they?

lines.zh: 让我展示如何孵化蛋吧。
lines.en: Let me show you how to hatch an egg.

lines.zh: 我能在空中翱翔，很酷吧？
lines.en: I can soar through the air, cool, right?

lines.zh: 你从未见过这样漂亮的鹦鹉嘴龙。
lines.en: You've never seen such a beautiful Psittacosaurus.

lines.zh: 我的叫声可以传遍山谷。
lines.en: My call can echo through the valley.

lines.zh: 来分享我的食物吧，很美味。
lines.en: Come share my food, it's delicious.
One low shove of my head and you step back.

lines.zh: 我要用我的头冠撞倒你。
lines.en: I'll use my crest to knock you down.

lines.zh: 我的身体很坚硬，不敢碰。
lines.en: My body is tough, don't touch.
I defend with body collisions.

lines.zh: 骨头硬，可你这一下不疼。
lines.en: Hard bone, yet your blow did not hurt.

lines.zh: 我的速度可以躲过攻击。
lines.en: My speed can evade your attacks.
I counter with headbutts.
Stay back, my crest is hard.
Make you afraid with my collision.
I'm strong, unaffected by collisions.
Find a mate, fly together.
Hatch our eggs together.

lines.zh: 我要找一个伴侣来繁殖。
lines.en: I'm looking for a mate to reproduce.
My eggs are key to reproduction.
Use my call to attract a mate.

lines.zh: 与我一起，创造新的生命。
lines.en: Create new life with me.
I have strong reproductive capabilities.

lines.zh: 我需要一个伴侣来交配。
lines.en: I need a mate to mate.
Explore new habitats together.

lines.zh: 我这嘴像鹦鹉，可不是用来学话的。
lines.en: My beak looks like a parrot's, but it does not talk.
Found my egg!
Don't touch my egg!

lines.zh: 我衔起这些嫩枝，堆到巢边。
lines.en: I carry these shoots over to the edge of my nest.
Get out of my way, little one!

lines.zh: 鹦鹉嘴一咬，果子就没了。
lines.en: One bite of my parrot beak and the fruit is gone.

lines.zh: 我把蛋往身下又挪了挪。
lines.en: I shift the eggs a little further under my body.
My egg is precious!
Watch out for those humans!

lines.zh: 我用前爪把蛋拢进蕨丛。
lines.en: I rake the eggs into the ferns with my foreclaws.
Watch out, I have teeth!

lines.zh: 我这嘴像鹦鹉，啃嫩芽正好。
lines.en: This parrot beak is right for tender shoots.
That fern patch is mine, stay back.
My prey is here!

lines.zh: 蕨叶尖上还挂着露水，正好。
lines.en: Dew still hangs on the fern tips; perfect.
Catch it and eat it!
Now's the chance!

lines.zh: 它往蕨丛里钻，我追上去。
lines.en: It dives into the ferns and I give chase.
It's mine!

lines.zh: 尝尝我的味道，肉在火上会香。
lines.en: Taste me; my meat smells fine over fire.
My teeth have a message!
That clump of ferns is moving.
I smell sweet fruit.
Let me see if it runs.
The low one is too small.

lines.zh: 我的鹦鹉嘴已经对准那丛嫩芽。
lines.en: My parrot beak is already aimed at that patch of shoots.

lines.zh: 那串浆果挂在低枝上，归我了。
lines.en: That bunch of berries on the low branch is mine.
Feel my teeth!

lines.zh: 这只小虫在我脚边，你不能捡。
lines.en: That bug at my feet is mine to take.
Prey is mine!
I'm eating it!
Let it taste my teeth!
My prey is it!
Eat it, don't let it get away!
Locked! Bite it!
I creep toward that clump of grass.
Beak open, ready to bite.

lines.zh: 它只顾低头啃蕨，我慢慢挪过去。
lines.en: It only grazes ferns, so I creep closer.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉的喙，嚼起草来正好。
lines.en: My parrot beak is perfect for grazing.
One step closer and I lunge.
Grrr, butts you with its horn!
Swings its forelimbs, trying to trip you!
Bites at your calf!
Low growl to scare you off!
Shows off its sharp teeth!

lines.zh: 用身体撞击，试图撞倒你！
lines.en: Butts you with its head!
Sssss, preparing to attack!

lines.zh: 用角抵住你，防止你靠近！
lines.en: Butts you to keep you away!

lines.zh: 发出尖锐叫声，警告入侵者！
lines.en: Rattling call to warn intruders!
Rushes to grab you!
A bite to your leg!
A hard peck from my beak!
A swing of my tail at you!
Both hind legs kick at you!
Hatches from an egg!
Rises from the ground, opens its mouth!

lines.zh: 从树洞中爬出来，准备觅食！
lines.en: Crawls out of a tree hole, ready to hunt!

lines.zh: 在岩洞中孵化，发出嘶嘶声！
lines.en: Hatches in a cave, sssss!

lines.zh: 从地下缓缓升起，张牙舞爪！
lines.en: Rises from the ground, fangs bared!

lines.zh: 在阳光下孵化，发出咯咯声！
lines.en: Hatches under the sun, grrs!

lines.zh: 从泥土中钻出，寻找食物！
lines.en: Emerges from the soil, searching for food!

lines.zh: 从卵中孵化，发出尖叫声！
lines.en: Hatches, emitting a sharp cry!

lines.zh: 在洞穴中孵化，发出低吼声！
lines.en: Hatches in a cave, low growls!

lines.zh: 从地面钻出，张开大嘴觅食！
lines.en: Emerges from the ground, opens its mouth!
An egg in the sand nest cracks open.
I push out of the ferns.
Walking in on my own shadow.
There is tender foliage around here.
A young Psittacosaurus trails its mother.
Peeking out from behind a dune.
Waking up out of the fossil bed.
I grew up in this fern forest.
A parrot beak can't bite fire.

lines.zh: 这一跤摔得我爬不起来。
lines.en: That fall knocked me off my feet.
Drowned, the water was cold

lines.zh: 我这点肉，烤熟了才好吃。
lines.en: My meat is only good roasted.
The arrow struck my back; my meat is still tender.

lines.zh: 我的喙还在抖，别再来一次。
lines.en: My beak is still trembling — do not do that again.
I'm starving, gotta find food
Lightning hit me, ouch!
Fall into void, ouch!
